panels.title: Usage by customer, key, client and model
panels.description: Daily request facts joined to authoritative usage_events. account_id identifies the engine customer and key_id the non-secret project key. Client attribution is self-reported. Models are database dimensions, not Prometheus labels.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_day, account_id, key_id, client_kind, client_source, requested_model, executable_model, provider_plane, request_class, SUM(request_count)::bigint AS request_count, SUM(billable_request_count)::bigint AS billable_request_count, SUM(input_tokens)::bigint AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens)::bigint AS output_tokens, SUM(real_nano)::bigint AS real_nano, SUM(charge_nano)::bigint AS charge_nano FROM request_fact_usage_daily WHERE usage_day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY usage_day, account_id, key_id, client_kind, client_source, requested_model, executable_model, provider_plane, request_class ORDER BY request_count DESC, usage_day DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Tool classes by customer, key and model
panels.description: Only the seven closed structural tool classes are shown. Tool names, schemas, arguments and results never enter the reporting view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_day, account_id, key_id, client_kind, client_source, requested_model, executable_model, provider_plane, request_class, tool_class, SUM(request_count)::bigint AS request_count, SUM(billable_request_count)::bigint AS billable_request_count, SUM(input_tokens)::bigint AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens)::bigint AS output_tokens, SUM(real_nano)::bigint AS real_nano, SUM(charge_nano)::bigint AS charge_nano FROM request_fact_tool_usage_daily WHERE usage_day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY usage_day, account_id, key_id, client_kind, client_source, requested_model, executable_model, provider_plane, request_class, tool_class ORDER BY request_count DESC, usage_day DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Tool choices and capability flags
panels.description: Unknown remains explicit when a producer did not measure a field. Tool counts use bounded buckets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_day, account_id, key_id, client_kind, client_source, tools_declared_bucket, tool_choice_mode, parallel_tools_requested, tool_results_in_input, tool_calls_in_output, structured_output, reasoning, SUM(request_count)::bigint AS request_count, SUM(billable_request_count)::bigint AS billable_request_count, SUM(input_tokens)::bigint AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens)::bigint AS output_tokens, SUM(real_nano)::bigint AS real_nano, SUM(charge_nano)::bigint AS charge_nano FROM request_fact_usage_daily WHERE usage_day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY usage_day, account_id, key_id, client_kind, client_source, tools_declared_bucket, tool_choice_mode, parallel_tools_requested, tool_results_in_input, tool_calls_in_output, structured_output, reasoning ORDER BY request_count DESC, usage_day DESC LIMIT 500

title: apiToken.sale Request Usage Dimensions
description: Private aggregate request analytics from read-only PostgreSQL views. Exact models and closed tool classes stay out of Prometheus labels.
